title: devex
content:
ian: hey team — trying to find the Platform onboarding checklist + our team playbook. where are these living? i need edit access to update my areas. cc @maria
maria: hey Ian! welcome. Team playbooks live in Docspace → Engineering → Platform → Onboarding & Checklists. quick link: https://redwood.notion.so/engineering/platform-onboarding-abc123 :point_left:
alex: If you need edit access, ping @devex or fill this form: https://forms.redwood.com/docs-edit-request. devex triages and grants editors. ian, want me to queue it for you?
devex-bot: Access request created for ian via /request-doc-edit. Request ID: req-2026-045. Status: pending reviewer
lisa: Also — on the page, click the 'Templates' (right sidebar) and pick 'New Hire Checklist' to copy into your workspace. When you edit owners, add yourself to the 'Owners' property so oncall knows who owns it.
ian: thanks! can someone paste the minimal steps to request edit? never used the form.
maria: minimal steps:
1. open the Notion page URL
2. click 'Share' (top-right) → 'Request access' or 'Invite' and add @devex
3. if that fails, fill the quick form and include the page URL + reason
form fields: Name, Email, Page URL, Desired permission (view/comment/edit), Short justification
or run: `/devex request-access <page-url> edit` — that'll create the ticket automatically.
maria: ping me if you get stuck, happy to approve editor requests for Platform pages. welcome aboard :tada:
